questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some spices are medicines.

All medicines are chemicals.

No chemical is cheap.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some medicines are cheap.

II. Some chemicals are spices.

III. No medicine is cheap.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some spices are medicines.

All medicines are chemicals.

No chemical is cheap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a809bd1a2d4faa8affe0bb18b033cd7847f6b4f3f02eb065de835ff19e33d2.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. Some medicines are cheap → **Does not follow **→ As all medicines are chemicals and no chemical is cheap. So some medicines are cheap is not definitely followed.

II. Some chemicals are spices → **Follow **→ As some spices are medicines and all medicines are chemicals. So some chemicals are spices is definitely followed.

III. No medicine is cheap → **Follow **→ As all medicines are chemicals and no chemical is cheap. So no medicine is cheap is definitely followed.

So, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to replace the mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs to balance the given equation.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **+, ÷, ×, =

**Given: **50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 + __**25 ÷ 10**__ × 2 = 175

⇒ 50 + 2.5 × 2 = 175

⇒ 50 + 5 = 175

⇒ 55 ≠ 175

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 2) **−, ×, ÷, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 - 25 × __**10 ÷ 2 **__= 175

⇒ 50 - __**25 × 5**__ = 175

⇒ __**50 - 125**__ = 175

⇒ - 75 ≠ 175

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 3) **−, ×, +, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 - __**25 × 10**__ + 2 = 175

⇒ __**50**__ - 250 __**+ 2 **__= 175

⇒ 52 - 250 = 175

⇒ - 198 ≠ 175

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 4) **+, ×, ÷, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 + 25 × __**10 ÷ 2**__ = 175

⇒ 50 + __**25 × 5**__ = 175

⇒ __**50 + 125 **__= 175

⇒ 175 = 175

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to interchange the signs and two numbers in the following equations to make it correct.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **10 and 19, - and +

**Given: **10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 19 × 11 - 10 + __**323 ÷ 3**__ = 50

⇒ __**19 × 11**__ - 10 + 107.66 = 50

⇒ __**209**__ - 10 __**+ 107.66 **__= 50

⇒ 316.6 - 10 = 50

⇒ 306.6 ≠ 50 

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 2) **3 and 19, - and ×

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 10 - 11 + 3 × __**323 ÷ 19**__ = 50

⇒ 10 - 11 + __**3 × 17**__ = 50

⇒ __**10**__ - 11 __**+ 51**__ = 50

⇒ __**61 - 11**__ = 50

⇒ 50 = 50

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

**Option 3) **10 and 11, - and ÷

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 11 × 10 + __**19 ÷ 323**__ - 3 = 50

⇒ __**11 × 10**__ + 0.0588 - 3 = 50

⇒ __**110 + 0.0588**__ - 3 = 50

⇒ __**110.0588 - 3**__ = 50

⇒107.0588 ≠ 50

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 4) **10 and 323, + and ÷

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 323 × __**11 ÷ 19**__ - 10 + 3 = 50

⇒ __**323 × 0.578**__ - 10 + 3 = 50

⇒ __**187**__ - 10 __**+ 3**__ = 50

⇒ 190 - 10 = 50

⇒ 180 ≠ 50

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be** not** correct?

× and +, 7 and 4

I. 7 × 8 + 4 – 6 ÷ 3 = 57

II. 4 × 8 – 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 3
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **× and +, 7 and 4

I. 7 × 8 + 4 – 6 ÷ 3 = 57

Given: × and +, 7 and 4

⇒ 4 + 8 × 7 – 6 ÷ 3 = 57

⇒ 4 + 8 × 7 - 2 = 57

⇒ 4 + 56 - 2 = 57

⇒ 60 - 2 = 57

⇒ 58 ≠ 57 (Not Correct)

II. 4 × 8 – 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 3

Given: × and +, 7 and 4

⇒ 7 + 8 – __**9 ÷ 3**__ × 4 = 3

⇒ 7 + 8 - __**3 × 4**__ = 3

⇒ __**7 + 8**__ - 12 = 3

⇒ __**15 - 12**__ = 3

⇒ 3 = 3 (Correct)

So, Only I is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
